categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Zhengye Technology primarily operates in industrial inspection intelligent equipment, serving lithium battery, PCB, flat panel display, and photovoltaic industries. The company provides industrial inspection, automation, intelligent manufacturing solutions, and new materials. It has exited the photovoltaic product manufacturing business in 2024 and focuses on industrial inspection intelligent equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including micro-focus X-ray imaging, high-speed vision positioning, constant temperature and pressure control, image processing, AI-assisted analysis, motion control, and process integration automation. It integrates X-ray nondestructive testing, machine vision, 3D imaging and reconstruction, machine learning, and real-time control technologies. Production follows a make-to-order model with customization to meet specific client process requirements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading manufacturers in lithium batteries, PCB, flat panel displays, and new energy sectors such as CATL, BYD, ATL, and major PCB companies. The company serves industries like new energy vehicles, electronics, semiconductors, and consumer electronics. Its products and services are recognized by numerous well-known domestic and international clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in East China, South China, and other domestic regions. It also exports products to Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America, covering dozens of countries and regions globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhengye Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, providing industrial inspection and automation equipment to manufacturing companies in downstream industries such as lithium battery production, PCB manufacturing, and flat panel display assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous innovation in X-ray detection technology, advancing 2D, 2.5D, and 3D inspection capabilities, and aims to achieve breakthroughs in industrial X-ray tomography. It emphasizes R&D in optical detection and automation control, expanding applications to semiconductor and electronic manufacturing. Strategic priorities include deepening core technology, expanding global markets, and developing diversified applications to enhance resilience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of industrial inspection equipment, automation production lines, intelligent manufacturing solutions, and high-end new materials. The company recognizes revenue upon transfer of control of goods or services to customers, primarily from product sales and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhengye Technology is a leading domestic supplier in the lithium battery intelligent inspection equipment sector with strong market presence. It holds a competitive position through proprietary technology, extensive project experience, and stable relationships with top-tier clients. However, it faces competition from international comprehensive leaders and aims to strengthen its scale and marketing capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 710.7 million, a 6.27% decrease year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 223.46 million. Total assets stood at RMB 1.52 billion, down 22.02%, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 216.78 million, down 50.65%. The company experienced a challenging market environment with intensified competition and asset impairments impacting profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhengye Technology emphasizes its technological innovation, especially in X-ray nondestructive testing and automation control, providing high-precision, customized inspection solutions that enhance product quality and safety for clients. Its integrated technology platforms and strong R&D capabilities enable it to offer comprehensive, tailored solutions that improve manufacturing efficiency and product reliability, differentiating it from competitors.
